{"decision": "APPLY", "workflow_yaml": "name: Go coverage

permissions:
  contents: read

  pull_request:
    branches: ["main"]
  push:
    branches: ["main"]
  # run at least once every 2 months to prevent the coverage artifact from expiring
  schedule:
    - cron: '14 3 2 */2 *'
  workflow_dispatch:

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.head_ref || github.run_id }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

defaults:
  run:
    shell: bash

jobs:
  go-coverage:
    name: Go coverage
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest-8-cores
    permissions:
      contents: read
      actions: read
      pull-requests: write

    steps:
      - name: Harden runner
        uses: step-security/harden-runner@46b06cea07f9e64621fdf066ba77ac6915163d43 # v2.22.3
        with:
          egress-policy: audit

      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          path: ${{ github.workspace }}/src/github.com/tektoncd/pipeline
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Set up Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@b7ad1dad31e06c5925ef5d2fc7ad053ef454303e # v7.0.0
        with:
          go-version-file: "${{ github.workspace }}/src/github.com/tektoncd/pipeline/go.mod"

      - name: Cache Go modules
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/go/pkg/mod
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-go-${{ hashFiles('src/github.com/tektoncd/pipeline/go.mod', 'src/github.com/tektoncd/pipeline/go.sum') }}

      - name: Generate coverage
        working-directory: ${{ github.workspace }}/src/github.com/tektoncd/pipeline
        run: |
          PACKAGES=$(go list ./... | grep -vE '/cmd(/|$)|/vendor(/|$)|/hack(/|$)|/test(/|$)|/fake(/|$)|/pkg/client(/|$)|/examples(/|$)|/tekton(/|$)')
          COVERPKG=$(echo $PACKAGES | tr ' ' ',')
          go test -coverprofile=coverage_raw.out -covermode=atomic -coverpkg="$COVERPKG" $PACKAGES
          grep -vE 'zz_generated\.deepcopy\.go|openapi_generated\.go' coverage_raw.out > coverage.out
          rm -f coverage_raw.out
          echo "Generated coverage profile"

      - name: Archive coverage results
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        with:
          name: code-coverage
          path: ${{ github.workspace }}/src/github.com/tektoncd/pipeline/coverage.out

      - name: Comment on PR
        if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'
        uses: fgrosse/go-coverage-report@c4bf7e78d1379325814b4dd42d80e526082e788b # v1.5.0
        continue-on-error: true # This may fail if artifact on main branch does not exist (first run or expired)
        with:
          coverage-artifact-name: "code-coverage"
          coverage-file-name: "coverage.out"

  codecov-upload:
    name: Upload coverage to Codecov
    needs: go-coverage
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    permissions:
      contents: read
      actions: read
      id-token: write

    steps:
      - name: Harden runner
        uses: step-security/harden-runner@46b06cea07f9e64621fdf066ba77ac6915163d43 # v2.22.3
        with:
          egress-policy: audit

      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Download coverage artifact
        uses: actions/download-artifact@9000827ccba6bdab643e8b6fd33ac0654aef8333 # v8.0.2
        with:
          name: code-coverage

      - name: Upload coverage to Codecov
        uses: codecov/codecov-action@303a32d7a59b442fa8d48b6a1cc6825c09c847a5  # v7.1.1
        continue-on-error: true
        with:
          files: coverage.out
          flags: unit-tests
          use_oidc: true
          fail_ci_if_error: false
          disable_search: true", "rationale": "The workflow is a Go coverage CI that repeatedly downloads Go module dependencies on every run (go.mod and go.sum exist in the repository). The P-LIT-GHA-CACHE pattern and the measured experiment batch-interactive-three--f6d2974a5cef7cc9 support caching Go module downloads, reporting 6.06% elapsed savings with all tests passing. Adding an actions/cache step for ~/go/pkg/mod keyed on go.mod/go.sum after Set up Go and before Generate coverage preserves all existing build/test coverage, adds no new network access, secrets, or privileged actions, and is a minimal change. The cache key accounts for the non-default checkout path under src/github.com/tektoncd/pipeline.", "evidence_ids": ["experiment:batch-interactive-three--f6d2974a5cef7cc9", "pattern:P-LIT-GHA-CACHE"]}
